policy: Existing exact fingerprints are debt. CI fails for every new or replacement fingerprint; moved line numbers do not create false positives.

rules.a11y-click-target: A non-semantic element has an onClick handler without complete keyboard semantics.
rules.a11y-focus-suppressed: An interactive control suppresses its outline without an explicit focus-visible replacement.
rules.a11y-icon-button-name: An icon-only button has no aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title.
rules.a11y-image-alt: An image has no alt attribute.
rules.a11y-touch-target: An icon-only control declares a target smaller than the 44px contract.
rules.feedback-browser-dialog: Product feedback uses window alert/confirm instead of an in-product surface.
rules.raw-color-value: A component contains a literal hex/rgb/hsl color outside the canonical token source.
rules.raw-modal-surface: A component creates a fixed full-screen modal outside shared UI primitives.
rules.raw-tailwind-color: A component uses a palette-specific Tailwind color instead of a semantic token.
rules.useful-text-opacity: Useful text is dimmed with opacity or a low-alpha text color.
